DOCX equations extract to LaTeX math in markdown output

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "xberg"
result = Xberg.extract(Xberg::ExtractInput.new(filename: 'equations.docx', kind: 'uri', mime_type: 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document', uri: 'https://example.com/docx/equations.docx'), { 'output_format' => 'markdown' })
puts result.results[0].content.inspect
```
